content: If development error detection is enabled, a PDU identifier is not within the specified range, and the PDU identifier is configured to be used by the PDU Router module, the PDU Router module shall report the error PduR.PDUR_- E_PDU_ID_INVALID to the DET module, when PduRDevErrorDetect is enabled.
